result.brief: 提出以槽位为中心的3D动态预训练框架，将点云帧分解为时序一致的槽位，并用逆/前向动力学模型学习逐槽位潜动作与未来状态预测，提升机器人操作表征的鲁棒性。
result.reason: Slot-centric 3D dynamics pretraining learns object-level latent actions and forward dynamics from point clouds, a representation contribution for world modeling; robot manipulation is the application.
